findings.title: "getMembership (404 if not a member)" wording could mislead on who throws
findings.location: Authorization summary table (List templates row); listTemplatesForWorkspace under GET /templates
findings.problem: getMembership returns null and never throws (verified in form.service.ts). The table shorthand reads as if the primitive itself produces the 404; the caller must translate null -> WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND.
findings.fix: In listTemplatesForWorkspace, state explicitly: call getMembership; if it returns null, throw a WORKSPACE_NOT_FOUND error (mirroring createForm). Footnote the table that the 404 is raised by the caller, not by getMembership.

findings.title: Custom-template create path drops folderId unlike duplicateForm, without calling it out
findings.location: Instantiating a custom template with fresh ids, step 4 (prisma.form.create field list)
findings.problem: duplicateForm copies folderId: form.folderId; the custom-create path omits folderId silently. Leaving it null is correct (no source folder) but is left implicit.
findings.fix: Add a line to step 4: folderId is intentionally left null (a template has no source folder); this differs from duplicateForm which copies the source folderId.

findings.title: questionCount degrade-to-0 on corrupt custom schema not surfaced in the picker UI note
findings.location: Error handling (List templates bullet); GET /templates response note; Web changes (picker option label)
findings.problem: A corrupt custom schema yields questionCount: 0 (getFormSchema tolerates malformed input) and still lists; the picker renders '(0 questions)' with no hint it is broken.
findings.fix: Note in Web changes that a custom template surfacing questionCount: 0 renders normally (acceptable for this lightweight surface); no special corrupt affordance required.
